title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding steady at $76,757—barely moving on the day despite extreme fear gripping markets at 25 on the Greed Index. That's your signal: capitulation sentiment while price remains anchored. 

Network fundamentals tell a different story. Hashrate sitting robust at 936.5 exahashes—miners aren't panicking, they're committed. That's bullish structural support when fear spikes.
